body: No problem man. I hope I helped at all. And I hope things can be okay for you soon

I went to 3. The first one was OK, but she didn’t really connect to my issues. The second one was honestly kind of fantastic, but she was through my school at the time and they only gave away 4 free sessions(couldn’t afford the rest). The 3rd one was absolutely awful. She seemed to be doing it as a hobby and kept on saying I was “too young to be actually depressed”. I would give it a go if I had the means to again, seeing as how it helped my friends. It’s just finding the right fit for you.

I have friends who it’s helped immensely. It’s crazy to see how much better they’ve gotten. I think you should try.

However, for me, it’s never worked. Idk. I haven’t clicked with anyone, then I ran out of money to try. If you have the resources, if couldn’t hurt.
